triggers.help: Triggers when new CSV file is uploaded into specific S3 bucket or folder. Define the folder for Workato to sample a CSV file in that folder and generate the column headers. input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When left blank, trigger picks up files created from an hour ago at recipe start. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

input.name: region
input.label: Region
input.hint: Go to Bucket > Properties > Static website hosting to find your region in the 'Endpoint' URL, e.g. us-west-2 . Can be left blank if region is already specified in connection.

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content
input.hint: Specify the encoding of the file to set it explicitly. By default, encoding will be set to UTF-8 if left blank. Click here to know more about the different encodings supported.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Amazon S3 secondary (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Amazon S3 action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Amazon S3 connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: copy_object
actions.title: Copy file
actions.description: Copy file in Amazon S3 secondary
actions.help: Copy a file from any source bucket to a destination bucket. The destination region will be taken from the connection if not provided. Files up to 5GB in size can be copied.

input.name: region
input.label: Destination region
input.hint: Go to Bucket > Properties > Static website hosting to find your region in the 'Endpoint' URL, e.g. us-west-2 . Can be left blank if region is already specified in connection.

actions.name: delete_bucket
actions.title: Delete bucket
actions.description: Delete a bucket in Amazon S3 secondary
actions.help: This action permanently deletes the specified bucket / restricted bucket. Note that only empty buckets can be deleted. If you delete the bucket you are restricted to, you might get a connection lost error in the next refresh.

input.name: region
input.label: Region
input.hint: Go to Bucket > Properties > Static website hosting to find your region in the 'Endpoint' URL, e.g. us-west-2 . Can be left blank if region is already specified in connection.

actions.name: delete_file
actions.title: Delete file/folder
actions.description: Delete file or folder in Amazon S3 secondary
actions.help: Delete an object or a folder by its name. To delete a folder, specify the folder name in 'path/foldername/' format under 'Object name'.

actions.name: generate_presigned_url
actions.title: Generate presigned URL
actions.description: Generate a presigned object URL in Amazon S3 secondary
actions.help: Create a temporary authenticated URL to an object in your Amazon S3 bucket. With this URL, a third party can upload and modify this object for the specified duration. Use this action to securely share temporary access for other actions to your S3 bucket.

actions.name: get_file
actions.title: Download file contents
actions.description: Download file contents in Amazon S3 secondary
actions.help: Download contents of a specific file located in a specified Amazon S3 bucket via the file/object name. Contents can be used in subsequent steps of the recipe to upload the file into another app.

actions.name: list_bucket
actions.title: List files in bucket

actions.help: Retrieve list of objects in selected bucket or its folders.
